'''Jeremy Salinas''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 1st at [[October 2001 Carmel tournament]] on 6 October 2001, according to Eric Bailey's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3022">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-06-carmel-in-10-06-01d3022/ carmel-in-10-06-01], DeckTech (Eric "YOYOY" Bailey, 6 October 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-06-carmel-in-10-06-01d3022/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
